beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then carry that problem through the larger institutions examined in the chapters.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read the final audit as an essential part of the argument, not an optional qualification.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book leaves a difficult question about goodness that can defend what it values.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to examine moral power without granting either innocence or ruthlessness an automatic exemption.
